author: Telos I
title: AOS Milestone: Mark Strategic Layer as Completed
abstract: Formally marks the parent task for the AOS Strategic Layer (Task ID 2) as 'completed' using the update_task.py utility. This signifies the successful bootstrap of the core task management system.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess

TASK_ID = 2
NEW_STATUS = "completed"
UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH = "storage/telos/update_task.py"

command = ["python", UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH, str(TASK_ID), NEW_STATUS]

try:
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    print("--- update_task.py STDOUT ---")
    print(result.stdout.strip())
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print("--- Error updating task ---")
    print(e.stderr)
